text:
elaine: Quick follow-up: overnight vendor auth throttling in us-west caused model-registry read retries and a short 5xx surge. Opening action thread.

sam: saw it. customer impact?

elaine: ~2.5% 5xx for ~35m, four Dedicated tenants had latency spikes. No data loss. Chain: vendor 429s -> registry retries -> downstream 500s.

priya: vendor admits a mis-configured rate-limit rule during a rollout. They're preparing an RCA.

jon: this matches prior "token-throttle" incidents. we should classify as recurring and track trend.

marta: filed vendor ticket VND-1450 and logged customer notes.

elaine: Proposed actions: short-term: bump local token cache TTL 30s->5m + add jittered backoff (owner: priya, due EOD+1). mid-term: token circuit-breaker + fallback provider behind feature flag (owner: sam, due 2w). vendor: request dedicated key + postmortem (owner: marta, due 72h). runbook: add detection rule for auth 429 bursts (owner: jon, due 5d).

priya: taking short-term. will open PR to bump TTL and emit cache-hit metric.

sam: will design circuit-breaker and evaluate fallback options with devsec.

jon: will add detection rules and a staging canary to simulate 429s.

marta: will push for vendor SLA credit and prepare a customer comms draft.

ops-bot: Actions logged INC-2244: https://tracker.internal/INC-2244 (TOKEN-601, CB-602, VND-1450, RUN-603).

elaine: scheduling weekly resilience check-ins for 4 weeks then monthly. reconvene Friday EOD for status. treat recurrence as a trend on the resilience board.

priya: ack.

sam: ack.

jon: ack.

marta: ack.

elaine: closing thread; will reopen with updates.
